{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Plains''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]]. It was situated on a continent in the eastern hemisphere, and separated the regions of the planet containing the [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Amma]] and [[Ril (city)|Ril]].
